newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai Golden Phillips gets syndicated loan.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai Golden Phillips gets syndicated loan.

text.p: Shanghai Golden Phillips Petrochemical Co Ltd, 60 percent owned by Shanghai Petrochemical Co Ltd, has signed a contract with a group of banks led by NatWest Markets for a syndicated loan of $33.73 million, a Shanghai Petrochemical official said on Tuesday.
The loan is guaranteed by the foreign joint venture partner, U.S.-based Phillips Petroleum Co Ltd which holds a 40 percent stake in the company, the official said.
Golden Phillips has also obtained a 420 million yuan loan from the Construction Bank of China, with Shanghai Petrochemical Co Ltd as the guarantor, he said but declined to give more details.
The loans will be used to fund the construction of a new linear polyethylene plant with total investment of $135.9 million, the Shanghai-based Wen Hui Bao newspaper said on Tuesday.
The project is expected to be completed in March 1998 with a annual production capacity of 100,000 tonnes of polyethylene, the newspaper said.
